verificationQueries.sql: select not has_function_privilege('public', 'flower_private.append_audit_event(uuid,uuid,text,text,text,jsonb)', 'execute') and not has_function_privilege('authenticated', 'flower_private.append_audit_event(uuid,uuid,text,text,text,jsonb)', 'execute') and has_function_privilege('service_role', 'flower_private.append_audit_event(uuid,uuid,text,text,text,jsonb)', 'execute') as verified;

select count(*) = 2 as verified from pg_trigger where tgrelid = 'public.audit_events'::regclass and tgname in ('audit_events_reject_row_mutation', 'audit_events_reject_truncate') and not tgisinternal;

rollbackGuidance: Drop the two mutation triggers and their trigger function, revoke and drop append_audit_event, then drop assert_safe_audit_payload. Existing audit records remain unchanged.
